records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (es)
records.text: Fragmentos de ADN liberados por las células tumorales a la sangre, detectables con secuenciación sensible.

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (es)
cfDNA fragmentomics (es)
records.text: Leer los tamaños y posiciones de los fragmentos de ADN en la sangre, no las mutaciones. Las células cancerosas mueren de forma desordenada y dejan un patrón reconocible.

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (es)
records.text: Un análisis de sangre que lee fragmentos de ADN liberados por el tumor, para genotipar o vigilar el cáncer sin una aguja en el tumor.

records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (zh)
records.text: 肿瘤细胞脱落到血液中的DNA片段，可用敏感测序检测。

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (zh)
Circulating tumour cell capture (zh)
records.text: 从血样中“钓出”完整癌细胞进行计数或研究；其数量在乳腺癌、前列腺癌和结直肠癌中具有预后意义。

records.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (zh)
records.text: 读取血液中DNA片段的大小和位置而非突变。癌细胞死得杂乱，留下可识别的碎片模式。

records.name: Cell-free DNA methylation tests (zh)
records.text: 读取肿瘤脱落DNA片段上化学标记的血液检测；这些标记可区分癌症DNA与正常DNA，并提示癌症所在部位。

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (zh)
records.text: 读取肿瘤脱落DNA片段的血液检测，无需穿刺肿瘤即可分型或监测。

records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (pt)
records.text: Fragmentos de DNA liberados por células tumorais no sangue, detectáveis com sequenciamento sensível.

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (pt)
cfDNA fragmentomics (pt)
records.text: Ler os tamanhos e posições dos fragmentos de DNA no sangue, não as mutações. Células cancerosas morrem de forma desordenada e deixam um padrão reconhecível.

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (pt)
records.text: Um exame de sangue que lê fragmentos de DNA liberados pelo tumor, para genotipar ou monitorar o câncer sem uma agulha no tumor.

records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (hi)
records.text: ट्यूमर कोशिकाओं द्वारा रक्त में छोड़े DNA टुकड़े, संवेदी अनुक्रमण से पकड़ने योग्य।

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (hi)
cfDNA fragmentomics (hi)
records.text: रक्त में DNA टुकड़ों के आकार और स्थान पढ़ना, म्यूटेशन नहीं। कैंसर कोशिकाएँ अव्यवस्थित रूप से मरती हैं और पहचानने योग्य विखंडन पैटर्न छोड़ती हैं।

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (hi)
records.text: रक्त जाँच जो ट्यूमर से निकले DNA टुकड़े पढ़ती है, ताकि ट्यूमर में सुई डाले बिना जीनोटाइप या निगरानी की जा सके।

records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (fr)
records.text: L'ADN tumoral circulant (ctDNA) est constitué de fragments d'ADN libérés par les cellules tumorales dans le sang, détectables par un séquençage sensible.

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (fr)
cfDNA fragmentomics (fr)
records.text: La fragmentomique analyse la taille et la position des fragments d'ADN dans le sang, et non les mutations. Les cellules cancéreuses meurent de façon désordonnée et laissent un schéma de fragmentation reconnaissable.

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (fr)
records.text: Un test sanguin qui lit les fragments d'ADN libérés par la tumeur, ce qui permet de génotyper ou de surveiller le cancer sans piquer la tumeur avec une aiguille.

records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (de)
records.text: Zirkulierende Tumor-DNA (ctDNA) besteht aus DNA-Fragmenten, die Tumorzellen ins Blut abgeben und die sich mit empfindlicher Sequenzierung nachweisen lassen.

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (de)
cfDNA fragmentomics (de)
records.text: Die Fragmentomik liest die Größe und Position von DNA-Fragmenten im Blut, nicht die Mutationen. Krebszellen sterben unordentlich ab und hinterlassen ein erkennbares Fragmentierungsmuster.

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (de)
records.text: Ein Bluttest, der DNA-Fragmente ausliest, die der Tumor abgibt, sodass sich der Krebs genotypisieren oder überwachen lässt, ohne eine Nadel in den Tumor zu stechen.

records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (ja)
records.text: 血中循環腫瘍DNA（ctDNA）は、腫瘍細胞から血液中に放出されたDNAの断片で、高感度のシーケンシングで検出できます。

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (ja)
cfDNA fragmentomics (ja)
records.text: フラグメントミクスは、血液中のDNA断片の大きさと位置を読み取るもので、変異を読むわけではない。がん細胞は乱雑に死ぬため、見分けやすい断片化パターンを残す。

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (ja)
records.text: 腫瘍から血液中に放出された DNA の断片を読み取る血液検査で、腫瘍に針を刺さずにがんの遺伝子型を調べたり経過を追ったりできる。

records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (ar)
records.text: الحمض النووي الورمي المنتشر (ctDNA) يتكون من شظايا DNA تطلقها الخلايا السرطانية في الدم، ويمكن كشفها بتقنيات تسلسل حساسة.

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (ar)
cfDNA fragmentomics (ar)
records.text: تقرأ الفراغمنتوميكس أحجام ومواقع شظايا الحمض النووي في الدم، لا الطفرات. تموت الخلايا السرطانية بطريقة غير منظمة وتترك نمط تفتت يمكن التعرف عليه.

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (ar)
records.text: فحص دم يقرأ شظايا الحمض النووي DNA التي يطلقها الورم، ما يتيح تحديد النمط الجيني للسرطان أو مراقبته دون إدخال إبرة في الورم.

records.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) (simple)
records.text: Cell-free DNA is DNA outside cells in a sample. Some may come from a tumour, but the total DNA amount is not a count of cancer cells.

records.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (simple)
records.text: Bits of DNA shed by tumour cells into the blood, detectable with sensitive tests.

records.name: ctDNA units, fractions and concentrations (simple)
records.text: A tumour-DNA result needs its unit. A concentration, a share of all measured DNA and a yes-or-no call answer different questions.

records.name: Lead time in ctDNA monitoring studies (simple)
records.text: The gap between a qualifying positive blood test and a later defined event. It depends on the study rules and sampling schedule and is not extra time added to life.

records.name: Circulating tumour cell capture (simple)
records.text: Circulating tumour cell capture fishes whole cancer cells out of a blood sample to count or study them, and the count predicts outcome in breast, prostate and colorectal cancer.

records.name: CellSearch circulating tumour cell count (simple)
records.text: A test that counts cells captured and identified under set rules in a blood sample. What the count means depends on the cancer, test and clinical question.

records.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (simple)
records.text: Reading the sizes and positions of DNA pieces in blood. Cancer cells die messily and leave a recognisable pattern.

records.name: Cell-free DNA methylation tests (simple)
records.text: Cell-free DNA methylation tests read chemical marks on DNA fragments shed by tumours into the blood, telling cancer DNA from normal DNA and hinting at where the cancer is.

records.name: Clonal haematopoiesis (CHIP) (simple)
records.text: A group of blood-forming cells with acquired changes can expand. DNA from that group can appear in a blood test and needs to be distinguished from tumour DNA.

records.name: Tumour-informed versus tumour-naive ctDNA assays (simple)
records.text: One method first selects features from a sampled tumour to track in blood. Another starts with predefined features. Their performance depends on the actual tests, samples and clinical question.

records.name: Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) (simple)
records.text: A blood test that reads bits of DNA shed by the tumour, so doctors can learn about the cancer without a needle in it.

A ctDNA result is a number with a unit. Molecules per millilitre, parts per million and allele fraction answer different questions, so a printed number means nothing until its unit and denominator are known.
Lead time is the measured gap between a first qualifying positive blood sample and a later clinical event. It depends on who is counted and when tests were done, and it is not extra life.
